content: In contrast to 2018, when we submitted BIBREF2 to BioASQ a system based on extractive summarization (and scored very high in the ideal answer category), this year we mainly targeted factoid question answering task and focused on experimenting with BioBERT. After these experiments we see the promise of BioBERT in QA tasks, but we also see its limitations. The latter we tried to address with mixed results using feature engineering. Overall these experiments allowed us to secure a best and a second best score in different test batches. Along with Factoid-type question, we also tried ‘Yes/No’ and ‘List’-type questions, and did reasonably well with our very simple approach.
